gotchas: Guest checkout, no login needed. Flow: search results 'See Availability' (same tab) -> hotel page 'Book Now' on a room -> 'Select a rate' page -> pick a 'Non-member Rate' row's 'Book Room' link (accessible name '<room> Guest rate - Book Room'; the 'Member price' links assume joining) -> one-page Guest information + Payment.
Search deep link works: /<state>/<city>/hotels?adults=1&checkInDate=YYYY-MM-DD&checkOutDate=YYYY-MM-DD. Parts of the header may render in the egress's language; prices stay in USD.

The guest form asks for name, email, country (defaults to United States), phone, postal code and state only: no street or city fields. Fields carry no autocomplete attributes; the ids/names in the overrides resolve.

Card fields are inline (not in an iframe): card number (name contains cardNumber), a SINGLE expiry text input #expirationDate (MM/YY, e.g. '02/30'), and name on card. No security-code field on the Flexible Rate (card guarantees the room). Fill name and expiry before the number.
'Join Choice Privileges for free' is PRE-CHECKED on the guest form; click its label to uncheck it. Unchecking disables nothing.

A sign-in panel (email + password) sits at the top of the checkout page; leave it alone for a guest booking. The page also shows a 'Reservation held for: 14:xx minutes' timer, so the checkout has to be filled within it.
Total shown as 'Current total $95.89' (one night, Flexible Rate, taxes included) in a credit-card upsell block; the proxy read it without a hint. Final button: 'Book Now'.
